title: minuartia gayana
intro: Minuartia gayana, commonly known as the Alpine Rockcress, is a species of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. The Alpine Rockcress is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help to soothe the respiratory tract and promote the removal of mucus. The bioactive constituents of the Alpine Rockcress include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
